input: Pitch a column idea to a local newspaper

gold.taskTitle: Pitch a Column Idea to a Local Newspaper
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to pitch an original column concept to a local newspaper and needs a plan to do it effectively.

questions.title: What topic or theme is your column about?
questions.description: Understand the subject matter of the column idea the user wants to pitch.

questions.title: Which specific local newspaper are you targeting?
questions.description: Identify the exact publication the user has in mind.

questions.title: Have you written for a newspaper or publication before?
questions.description: Gauge the user's prior writing or publishing experience.

questions.title: Do you already have a contact name or editor's email?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has an existing point of contact at the newspaper.

questions.title: Do you have writing samples ready to attach?
questions.description: Find out if the user has existing work to support the pitch.

questions.title: Is this a paid opportunity or are you open to unpaid?
questions.description: Clarify the user's expectations around compensation for the column.

questions.title: What is your deadline for sending this pitch?
questions.description: Establish any time constraints the user is working within.
